page.layout: One printed page of running text, one column. Running head "PRÆFATIO" centred at the top. No page number, catchword or signature. No marginal notes. The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: endi, struxere muros in pace, tanquam ad bellum. Jam constat satis, Templum a reducibus Iudaeis primo exstructum & quod Pompejus ingressus fuit, fuisse idem: atqui in Taciti verbis urbem templumque hoc munita tantum fuisse, non de integro exstructum templum, significatur; quin etiam Claudij demum temporibus, non Herodis, illam mutationem factam hic legimus. Huc lector advertat animum, quo argumentum quod ex Hagg. cap. 2. desumi solet stabilire queat. Si quis ulterius in causam inquirat, quare Herodis structura cum illâ[?] Cyri permissu exstructâ habeatur eadem, hoc secum expendat: prius aedificium a posteriori censeri diversum, quia illo invitis possessoribus diruto, longum intercesserat temporis intervallum, quo secundum, a reducibus Iudaeis reparatum, ab illo priori secretum ac separatum fuit; ex materia etiam diversa exstructum. At a secunda structurâ illa Herodis longo illo temporis intervallo separata non fuit; sed continuo successit: nec illa invitis possessoribus fuit devastata; sed omnium consensu veluti in praestantiorem permutata: nec tanta hic diversitas; sed, quamvis multa e diversa, plurima etiam ex eadem materia fuere restituta. Quocirca senex ille qui Herodi respondisse fertur (Iosephi pseudogorionidae hist. lib. 6. cap. 55.) inter alia dicebat, אחר חסיר את הבית הראשון והקריש אבניו ורעפיו ואת חלקי בכינו לקרושה בנין הבית הגדול שהבנה, poftea removeris aedem priorem (respectu istius quam Herodes volvebat animo) & sanctificaveris lapides ejus tegulasque ejus membra-

page.notes: The Hebrew line is somewhat blurred; the transcription follows the visible letters but the vowel-less forms of the first line and the end of the second line are not fully certain. The italic/roman boundaries are judged from the scan. The Hebrew and Latin share the same printed line at the break before "poftea". The mark after "illâ" and "structurâ" is copied as printed and may be a tilde or stroke over a rather than a macron. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears at lower left and is not transcribed.
